title: Alacrity | Shulker Box Tooltip Support
description: Retexture of Shulker Box Tooltip in Alacrity style
body:
[](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity-shulker-box-tooltip-support) [](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/alacrity-shulker-box-tooltip-support) ---
An **unofficial compatibility pack** designed to align the aesthetics of [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) mod with the [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity) resource pack. This pack is **100% completed** and **can be customized** using the `Configuration Menu`, as follows: - **Disable Color Overlay** : `Configs → Colors → Colored Preview Window = No` - **Modify Color** : `Configs → Colors → Shulker Boxes = #RRGGBB` **Note:** - For the best experience, use this pack alongside [Alacrity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alacrity). - For Bug Report / Suggestion, please DM me on my **Discord (@thedatthai)**. **Credits:** - [Satellence](https://modrinth.com/user/Satellence) - Creator of Alacrity - [MisterPeModder](https://modrinth.com/user/MisterPeModder) - Creator of Shulker Box Tooltip ## Showcase ![Showcase (GUI)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/284443ff516d298794961ecece696aa40ee84522.png)
